## Integrity checks

| check | result |
|---|---|
| slice MAC verifies (KMAC256, 16 bytes) | ok |
| slice MAC rejects a flipped payload bit | ok |
| slice MAC rejects a replayed frame number | ok |
| a slice under the shadow key slot fails the primary key | ok |
| U6 strict parse rejects out-of-order header fields | ok |
| U6 strict parse rejects a non-minimal varint | ok |
| input chain head detects one altered batch in 480 | ok |
| input batch tag verifies | ok |
| Merkle root of 240 frames detects a forged frame | ok |
| shadow chain head equals primary chain head (zero-frame handover) | ok |
| receipt signing scope is identical in both encoders | ok |
| version negotiation picks the highest common minor | ok |
| R1..R10 each map to one error code 301..310 | ok |

Message types covered: 50 of 50. Envelope bodies covered: 31 of 31.
